correctness.rationale: A complete Vandermonde-Schur reduction makes every minor zero exactly at an integer positive ten-term root sum. Cyclotomic linear disjointness gives the exact p|v|+3T=10 constraint; elementary complete residue-pair histograms rule out all cases except p=5 with columns in one modulo-three class. The fifth-root generating function proves the converse, and rank three follows from the three initial Vandermonde rows. The packaged all-integer checker verifies 130521 minors at four primes without exceptions; analytic proof handles all p≥5.

value.rationale: For composite Fourier orders, divisor-uniformity is necessary but not generally sufficient for full spark. The result determines an infinite squarefree-composite family where the canonical near-consecutive four-row pattern is full spark, resolves the potentially exceptional small CRT moduli, and quantifies exactly fifteen rank-three failures at the single exceptional order. This bridges the prime-power classification with known composite failures and is not a trivial index relabeling.
